description: Precedence (ADR 0026 §2 as clarified by ADR 0048: shape and limits, then signature base64url, then protected-header decoding (base64url, JSON, then per-parameter types and crit syntax), then the payload's base64url under the effective b64, then whole-header structure, then ADR 0026 §2 steps 5–9): a compact JWS whose protected header decodes to the unterminated {"alg":"HS256" (JSON) and whose payload is padded (payload base64url) fails with the JSON code
